ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES001_003.source_new: These bridges weren’t built for ogres, we need to be careful next time.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES001_004.source_old: Damn it… we needed those catapults.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES002_002.source_old: Men! We’re under attack! Destroy these monsters in the name of our king! For Stromgarde! For Trollbane!
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES002_002.source_new: Men! We’re under attack! Destroy these monsters in the name of our king! For Stromgarde! For Trollbane!

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES003_001.source_old: These are very old ruins, impressive. The style and might of these dwarves rival the draenei and even the ogres of Goria.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES003_001.source_new: These are very old ruins, impressive. The style and might of these dwarves rival the draenei and even the ogres of Goria.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES004_001.source_old: Hmmmm, whoever made this camp must have been very busy unearthing artifacts from this ancient stronghold.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES004_001.source_new: Hmmmm, whoever made this camp must have been very busy unearthing artifacts from this ancient stronghold.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_001.source_old: A spirit! What happened to you, why do you haunt this place?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_001.source_new: A spirit! What happened to you, why do you haunt this place?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_002.source_old: Zuluhed?, I…. I ran away, we were attacked, put in chains…… and I ran away, without freeing my fellow brethren… I failed them.’’
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_002.source_new: Zuluhed?, I… I ran away, we were attacked, put in chains…… and I ran away, without freeing my fellow brethren… I failed them.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_003.source_old: Such a cruel fate.. if we release all your friends, will your spirit then be at peace?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_003.source_new: Such a cruel fate.. if we release all your friends, will your spirit then be at peace?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_004.source_old: yes, yes it would be…..please free them…
ToD_A02_M06_VO_ES005_004.source_new: Yes, yes it would be…..please free them…

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_001.source_old: What’s the matter, Chieftain? You don’t seem content.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_001.source_new: What’s the matter, Chieftain? You don’t seem content.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_002.source_old: I do not fancy humid lands, Utok. First it was Tanaan, then the Black Morass and now… this place.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_002.source_new: I do not fancy humid lands, Utok. First it was Tanaan, then the Black Morass and now… this place.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_003.source_old: As expected from an orc born of the dry lands of Gorgrond.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_003.source_new: As expected from an orc born of the dry lands of Gorgrond.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_004.source_old: Yes. These damp swamps dull my senses… but I must carry on regardless. Now tell me, how did a young orc like yourself find himself practicing the ways of the Shamans?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_004.source_new: Yes. These damp swamps dull my senses… but I must carry on regardless. Now tell me, how did a young orc like yourself find himself practicing the ways of the Shamans?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_005.source_old: Ever since Doomhammer toppled the Shadow Council’s grip on the horde, I wanted to embrace the ways of our ancestors. I hate what Gul’dan and his foul demonic filth did to our race, and to our history.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_005.source_new: Ever since Doomhammer toppled the Shadow Council’s grip on the horde, I wanted to embrace the ways of our ancestors. I hate what Gul’dan and his foul demonic filth did to our race, and to our history.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_006.source_old: What has happened to us is…regrettable, I am hopeful that Orgrim will eventually lead us to victory and help us build a new future for our people on this world, far removed from demons and their vile corruption.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_006.source_new: What has happened to us is…regrettable, I am hopeful that Orgrim will eventually lead us to victory and help us build a new future for our people on this world, far removed from demons and their vile corruption.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_007.source_old: With that, I suggest we shift our focus to the task at hand. Has there been any word about the nature of this ‘special envoy’ that we are meant to protect?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_007.source_new: With that, I suggest we shift our focus to the task at hand. Has there been any word about the nature of this ‘special envoy’ that we are meant to protect?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_008.source_old: No Chieftain, the messenger did not reveal any more details. I suspect we’ll find out soon enough.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S001_008.source_new: No Chieftain, the messenger did not reveal any more details. I suspect  we’ll find out soon enough.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S002_001.source_old: Cho’gall?! He is the special envoy? I never imagined that Doomhammer would insult me by letting me play bodyguard for Gul’dan’s treasonous pet.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S002_001.source_new: Cho’gall?! He is the special envoy? I never imagined that Doomhammer would insult me by letting me play bodyguard for Gul’dan’s treasonous pet.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S002_002.source_old: This is also a surprise for me, Zuluhed. I know that this might not be to your liking, but you must put your trust in our Warchief’s wisdom. Doomhammer picked you because he knows that you’re the most trustworthy leader that we have in Khaz Modan.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S002_002.source_new: This is also a surprise for me, Zuluhed. I know that this might not be to your liking, but you must put your trust in our Warchief’s wisdom. Doomhammer picked you because he knows that you’re the most trustworthy leader that we have in Khaz Modan.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_003.source_new: Such insolence! Want me to slice his tongue, Chieftain Cho’gall?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_008.source_new: As you say… What can you tell us about your mission?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_009.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r We are to head through these dangerous swamps to the dwarven stronghold of Grim Batol. The Bleeding Hollow clan awaits us there. After that we will depart to the eastern shores to inspect our oil refineries.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_009.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r We are to head through these dangerous swamps to the dwarven stronghold of Grim Batol. The Bleeding Hollow clan awaits us there. After that we will depart to the eastern shores to inspect our oil refineries.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_010.source_old: |cffffcc00Gall:|r However, one problem stands in our way. Humans and dwarves roam this place in great numbers, and we don’t have the time to attack them directly.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_011.source_old: The night’s veil will help us pass through these lands mostly unseen, but we must reach Grim Batol before the sun rises. Let us move out.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S003_011.source_new: The night’s veil will help us pass through these lands mostly unseen, but we must reach Grim Batol before the sun rises. Let us move out.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S005_002.source_old: Sunrise isn’t far off… we must make up our minds quickly.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S005_002.source_new: Sunrise isn’t far off… we must make up our minds quickly.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S005_007.source_new: Both paths are dangerous, but we cannot wait.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S006_001.source_old: It would be lovely destroying the Alliance with their own weapons…
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S006_001.source_new: It would be lovely destroying the Alliance with their own weapons…

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_001.source_old: Greetings Chieftains! We’ve been expecting you!
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_001.source_new: Greetings Chieftains! We’ve been expecting you!

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_002.source_old: Throm'ka warriors! Seems like a lot of you were wounded.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_002.source_new: Throm'ka warriors! Seems like a lot of you were wounded.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_003.source_old: We’ve been fighting the humans and their scummy dwarven allies day and night for weeks now… our numbers have been decreasing fast and many of our warriors have been captured. If you help us free our brethren, we will gladly join your cause!
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_003.source_new: We’ve been fighting the humans and their scummy dwarven allies day and night for weeks now… our numbers have been decreasing fast and many of our warriors have been captured. If you help us free our brethren, we will gladly join your cause!

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_004.source_old: Very well, warrior, we are not in the business of letting friends rot in Alliance cages.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_004.source_new: Very well, warrior, we are not in the business of letting friends rot in Alliance cages.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_005.source_old: Lok'tar Ogar! Chieftain Kilrogg will be most pleased with your aid!
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S007_005.source_new: Lok'tar Ogar! Chieftain Kilrogg will be most pleased with your aid!

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S008_001.source_old: If you see any Alliance Scum, let me know...
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S008_001.source_new: If you see any Alliance Scum, let me know...

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_001.source_old: Come filth! You will not find an…huh? Chieftain Zuluhed of the Dragonmaw? How is this possible?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_001.source_new: Come filth! You will not find an…huh? Chieftain Zuluhed of the Dragonmaw? How is this possible?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_002.source_old: At ease, young blood, what has happened to you?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_002.source_new: At ease, young blood, what has happened to you?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_003.source_old: We were..fighting those damnable dwarves when this gigantic beast came out of the shadows and slaughtered everyone, orc and dwarf alike.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_003.source_new: We were..fighting those damnable dwarves when this gigantic beast came out of the shadows and slaughtered everyone, orc and dwarf alike.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_004.source_old: It was bigger than any Draenor Basilisk that I’ve ever seen, scales white as snow and hard as rocks…
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_004.source_new: It was bigger than any Draenor Basilisk that I’ve ever seen, scales white as snow and hard as rocks…

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_005.source_old: …teeth sharp as daggers. I was..the only survivor, I managed to crawl my way out from it’s reach…please, avenge our fallen brethren… find this demon and kill it!
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S009_005.source_new: …teeth sharp as daggers. I was..the only survivor, I managed to crawl my way out from it’s reach…please, avenge our fallen brethren… find this demon and kill it!

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S010_001.source_old: There you are…you’re no demon though…just a poor creature protecting it’s land, but…the lives you have taken should not go unavenged.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S010_001.source_new: There you are…you’re no demon though…just a poor creature protecting it’s land, but…the lives you have taken should not go unavenged.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S010_002.source_old: Hmm.. what should I do? Heal you and leave you in peace or avenge my brethren? What do the spirits ask of me?
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S010_002.source_new: Hmm.. what should I do? Heal you and leave you in peace or avenge my brethren? What do the spirits ask of me?

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S011_001.source_old: The beast will trouble you no more, young blood, rest now and rejoin our warriors when you can.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S011_001.source_new: The beast will trouble you no more, young blood, rest now and rejoin our warriors when you can.

ToD_A02_M06_VO_S011_002.source_old: Thank you, Chieftain, please accept this token of my appreciation.
ToD_A02_M06_VO_S011_002.source_new: Thank you, Chieftain, please accept this token of my appreciation.
